name: Eni
note: Re-rated 2026-10-06 (#183): concern - the link is the Italian state's 33.084% stake in Eni (MEF 2.166% direct + 30.918% via Cassa Depositi e Prestiti, itself 82.77% MEF-owned), per Eni's 2026 AGM filing and Eni's Form 20-F FY2025 (Item 7: the Ministry of Economy and Finance controls Eni), alongside golden-share powers. Matches the repo's part-state precedent (lenovo 29.04% state-owned CAS Holdings; motorola-mobility ~9.5% Chinese state; standard-chartered/Temasek; noon/PIF 50%). The 2026-09-28 hold is resolved: the two-source evidence chain is now on the claim, the unsourced conflict-exposure sentence has been dropped, and no sourced abuse claim against the MEF/CDP owner chain was found.

why.text: The Italian state holds 33.084% of Eni - the Ministry of Economy and Finance 2.166% directly and 30.918% through Cassa Depositi e Prestiti, which the ministry itself controls with 82.77% - and Eni's own 20-F states that the Ministry of Economy and Finance controls Eni. So about a third of the money behind Eni is the Italian state's, with golden-share powers beside it. On the record side: Eni, the ministry and CDP are all defendants in a pending climate-responsibility suit before the Civil Court of Rome brought by Greenpeace Onlus, ReCommon APS and 12 private citizens (disclosed in Eni's 20-F) - pending, not a finding - and no sourced court, regulator, UN or major-NGO finding against the state-owner chain was located. Concern on the state-stake link, with the record left for a maintainer to weigh.
why.messageLine: The Italian state holds about a third of Eni; Eni, the state holding ministry and its lender are defendants in a pending climate suit in Rome.
